name: Blinn-Phong Shading in Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that uses ray marching with Blinn-Phong lighting to render 3D volumes, specifically implemented in the `ossium` project for WebGPU.
summary: Blinn-Phong Shading in Volume Rendering applies the Blinn-Phong reflectance model to SDF-derived normals, distinguishing itself by using a computationally cheaper half-vector approximation for specular highlights.
